description: T-2242: PPMT's first period over terms of 1 to 400 at rates 0.1 and 0.05, with the PMT of the same term, to fit how Excel discounts PMT to period 1 (A166 of m9-fin-pmt is PPMT(0.1,1,360,10000)).

cells.G1: T-2242: row n holds PPMT(r,1,n,10000) and PMT(r,n,10000) for r = 0.1 (A, B) and 0.05 (D, E), n = 1..400, and EXP(-n*LN(1.1)) (C).
